definitions.explanation: A device used to close or seal an opening — a bottle cap, cork, drain plug, faucet, or any kind of stopper.

examples.japanese: ボトルの{栓|せん}を{抜|ぬ}く。
examples.english: Pull the cork from the bottle.

examples.japanese: {風呂|ふろ}の{栓|せん}を{閉|し}め{忘|わす}れた。
examples.english: I forgot to put the plug in the bathtub.

examples.japanese: {消火栓|しょうかせん}の{前|まえ}には{駐車|ちゅうしゃ}しないでください。
examples.english: Please do not park in front of the fire hydrant.

notes:
A general word for any kind of stopper, plug, cork, or tap that seals or controls flow through an opening.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {栓|せん}を{抜|ぬ}く — to pull a cork/plug
- {栓|せん}を{閉|し}める — to close a plug/stopper
- {栓|せん}をする — to plug, to cork
- {栓|せん}を{開|あ}ける — to open a tap/valve

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {栓抜|せんぬ}き — bottle opener, corkscrew
- {消火栓|しょうかせん} — fire hydrant
- {水栓|すいせん} — faucet, water tap
- {蛇口|じゃぐち}の{栓|せん} — faucet tap
- {血栓|けっせん} — blood clot, thrombus
- {脳血栓|のうけっせん} — cerebral thrombosis

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ふた — lid, cap (more general, for containers)
- コルク — cork (the material)
- {蓋|ふた} — lid, cover (broader range of closures)
